headline: Colombia Faces Projected $22 Billion Fiscal Adjustment for 2027
summary: Colombia's vice president stated that the country needs a fiscal adjustment of nearly $22 billion for 2027, following government decrees that cut the 2026 budget by $4.3 billion.
why: Significant budget cuts and required fiscal adjustments indicate sovereign debt pressures and can impact government spending and economic growth projections.

impacts.name: Colombia
impacts.why: Substantial fiscal adjustments and budget cuts point to tightening government expenditures.
